pages.title: Hazmat Gear
pages.text: Hazmat gear protects you from polluted air. Wearing the full set makes you immune to CO2 damage, toxin poisoning, and microplastic slowness. It also shows you an air quality display — three bars for CO2, Oxygen, and Toxins.

pages.title: Hazmat Helmet
pages.text: The most important piece. The helmet filters the air you breathe and enables the air quality HUD. Even just wearing the helmet provides full air protection.
Craft using rubber and other materials.
